title: B-tree cell-size cache computation and lookup

scope.rationale: computeCellSize calculates and stores a missing cell size, while cachedCellSize returns an existing size or delegates to the computation path.

external_source_responsibilities: Page-specific cell-size callback semantics represented by leaf length or cellSizeNoPayload
dependencies.caller_closure: Both complete helpers and the population caller that consumes their cache state are assigned in the production B-tree owner.

inputs: Cell array and in-range cell index
outputs: Computed or cached cell byte size
contracts.ownership: Cell buffers are borrowed; only the parallel size slot is mutated.
contracts.state_and_results: compute requires an empty size slot and stores the computed value. cached returns a nonzero slot unchanged or computes and stores it.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller owns the B-tree mutex. No I/O or callbacks outside the page-specific size calculation.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Zig reports Range or Corrupt for invalid bounded representation; a failed computation leaves the cache slot zero.

representation_differences: Zig uses bounded slices and usize sizes instead of C pointer arrays and u16 cache entries, and returns explicit range/corruption errors.

oracle.protocol: Trace an empty cache slot through computation, then repeat through the cached path and verify no size change.
oracle.normalization: Valid cell sizes compare as exact integers.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; caller owns B-tree synchronization.
assurance.malformed_input: Bounds and malformed non-leaf cells return explicit errors.
assurance.continuation: Failed computation preserves the zero cache slot.
assurance.performance: Cached lookup is constant time; miss performs one bounded cell-size decode.

integration.native_call_path: Cell-cache population invokes computeCellSize for empty slots; balancing owners consume the populated size array.

independent_review.notes: Requires pinned-C trace, assurance closure, and independent review.
